name: codex-rdd-quality
purpose: Shared native Gentle RDD/Judgment Day routing for prepared-ticket execution. Reviewer roles remain distinct; Codex transport limits reviewer models to Codex-supported model IDs.
notes: The four RDD lenses remain separate reviewer agents; Codex is transport, not one monolithic reviewer.
V4/GLM/MiMo are not valid reviewer assignments on the qualified Codex transport unless the local Codex runtime itself exposes those model IDs; the current Gentle Codex catalog is OpenAI-model based.
Refuter is conditional on provider rules; deterministic severe findings may skip refutation.
Judgment Day is explicit-only and is not an automatic post-RDD phase.
